source: Shimano SM-SH51 SPD single-release cleat (also fits SM-SH56 pedals/cleat sets): two M5 cleat bolts 15 mm centre to centre (forum reports for 'SPD, SPD-R and clones'; NOT a Shimano drawing), fore-aft adjustment 20 mm and lateral 5 mm (Shimano PD-M520 dealer text), bolts tightened 2.5 N*m then 5 to 6 N*m with a 4 mm hex key (same). Overall size and the recess are UNVERIFIED.
frame: cleat: X along the shoe's fore-aft direction (travel direction), Y across the shoe (parallel to the pedal axle), Z up; origin at the centre of the cleat footprint on its MOUNT_FACE (the face that is bolted against the shoe sole or, here, the adapter); the cleat body and its engagement hardware extend toward -Z, the bolts are inserted from -Z toward +Z

height.source: UNVERIFIED (Robin to measure): same retailer text: overall height from the mount face down to the bottom of the cleat

bolt_head_diameter.source: UNVERIFIED (Robin to measure): assumed equal to an ISO 4762 M5 head (dk 8.5); the Shimano cleat bolt head is flatter and may differ

recess_depth.source: UNVERIFIED (Robin to measure): how far the cleat's mount face sits above the shoe's pedal-contact (sole) surface, so that the cleat protrudes (height - recess_depth) below the sole; assumed 3 mm, not found in any source

bolt_seat_depth.source: UNVERIFIED (Robin to measure): depth below the mount face of the floor on which the cleat bolt head bears (the cleat's thickness at the bolt holes; the head is counterbored into the cleat). Assumed height - 5.0 so that an ISO 4762 M5 head (k 5.0) stands flush with the cleat's lower face; the real Shimano cleat bolt head is flatter and the true seat depth is not in any source found

notes: Envelope only: the cleat body is a plain box, the clip-in hooks and bearing surfaces are not modelled. The bolt line is assumed along the travel direction (X); the 15 mm pitch is for the two cleat bolts. The keepout 'recess' is the cavity the adapter must leave open round the cleat between its mount face and the sole plane; 'bolt_travel' is the swept plan area of the two bolt axes (+ head) over the full fore-aft and lateral adjustment ranges, which the adapter's bolt slots and nut seats must cover. Standard cleat hardware for the adapter is catalogue bolt_m5_iso4762 and nut_m5; the Shimano cleat nut plate is not used. The bolt heads bear on BOLT_SEAT (counterbored into the cleat's lower face); the bolt shank then runs +Z through the mount face into the adapter.
import_gate_notes: R1: bounding box = length x width x height, tolerance 0.2 mm (plain box envelope). Datum directions are unit vectors. Designed contact (cleat mount face against the adapter, bolts in their holes) is not interference. The recess and bolt_travel keepouts are reserved volumes, not solids.
